name: Tao Weighing
description: Weigh the foe's intent against the Way and lay on them the difference as weight.

name: Law Piercing
description: Pierce a guard by the one law it has not met and the point goes through.

name: Tao Wholeness
description: Return a wounded ally to the course of a whole body until the wound is only a memory.

name: Even Calm
description: Level the whole field of strife to one even calm and lay low whatever stood above it.

name: Law Nullified
description: Meet a great technique with its natural opposite until neither remains.

name: Tao Vanishing
description: Pass through the world as through open air with nothing to mark the way taken.

name: Timeless Pace
description: Take a single step that crosses a field and lands before the foot has left the ground.

name: Pure Compliance
description: Strike in pure compliance with natural law so nothing that opposes it can stand.

name: Easeful Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of ease that no blow can find a way into.

name: Tao Decree
description: Decree by the Way that a foe's power be set aside until they come into accord.

name: Silent Way
description: Walk the Way in silence across the field so that all strife dies where it was about to begin.

name: Law Unmaking
description: Unmake all that stands against natural law within a reach no wider than the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Unspoken Tao
description: The act simply comes to pass as if the world had always allowed it with no cause that any qi can account for.

name: Nameless Hand
description: Strike with a hand that has no name and so is met by no guard made for it.

name: Unbidden Calm
description: Let a calm descend that no one asked for and no one can refuse.

name: Nameless Mending
description: Mend an ally by an unnamed Way until the hurt has no place left to rest.

name: Tao Gathering
description: Gather the field into one stillness and let it close upon every foe in reach.

name: Nameless Guard
description: Take any blow into the nameless Way where it can no longer be called a blow.

name: Nameless Passage
description: Pass through the world by a path that has no name and leaves no sign.

name: Nameless Flash
description: Cross any distance in the time it takes to stop looking at it.

name: Nameless Tao Edge
description: Strike with an edge the world has no word for so no guard knows how to turn it.

name: Nameless Binding
description: Bind a foe in a hold that has no knot and no end.

name: Nameless Decree
description: Decree without naming that a foe's power rest until the decree is forgotten.

name: Nameless Reign
description: Reign over the field by no title and no force and still every foe within it.

name: Nameless End
description: End all strife within a reach set by the ceiling of the user's tier with no word to mark the end.

name: Way Unnamed
description: The foe's technique is denied ever having been used and the world holds that it was not.

name: Source Returned
description: Return an ally and the ground they stand on to the state before the harm with no cost that qi can name.
